description: This source file defines the PathEvaluator class, which implements Android's TypeEvaluator interface to interpolate between PathPoint objects during animations. It calculates intermediate PathPoint values based on the progress parameter t, supporting different operations like CURVE and LINE.

classes.name: PathEvaluator
classes.description: A class that evaluates and interpolates between PathPoint objects for animations, supporting curved and linear transitions.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the intermediate PathPoint between startValue and endValue based on the fraction t, supporting different interpolation operations.
